gloss_en: IDS check on Tag of IfcSign fails: why does the type's Tag not inherit to instances?
title_original: IDS checking attributes inherited from IfcTypeObject
question_paraphrase: put a Tag on IfcSignType expecting each IfcSign to inherit it, IDS says fail; wanted all IfcSign.PICTORAL to match a pattern. attached ifc and ids
phrasing_notes: short, concrete, attaches files, no greeting fluff
answer_summary: Tag, Name, Description, GlobalId are not inherited from type; use Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation or IfcClassificationReference with bSDD. An Australian maintainer suggested buildingSMART Australia could steward local property sets.

gloss_en: NZ social housing provider is trying to work out what BIM or IFC means for an organisation owning a large housing stock

phrasing_notes: owner-side voice, vague, no specific question
answer_summary: Replied that proprietary formats expire (Revit files roughly 3-5 years), so portfolio owners need open IFC, native IFC authoring, exchange platforms and cloud viewers.

gloss_en: I built a browser IFC editor with an AI assistant to reclassify proxy elements; beginner asks how others do AI-assisted Bonsai tooling for NZ code

answer_summary: Replies debated vibe-coding vs reading the code; one maintainer warned about unreviewed AI code; method was brief then design then code then test.

gloss_en: Furnishing IFC sets differ per country; AU and NZ sizes overlap but not fully, so a column per country is needed

answer_summary: Community started shared spreadsheet of typical architectural dimensions with a column per country, each region maintains its own data.

gloss_en: Exported attributes to CSV, edited in LibreOffice, reimported, and nothing changed
title_original: [BlenderBIM] IFC CSV tool
question_paraphrase: exported attributes (Name, type), edited in LibreOffice, reimported the csv but nothing changed in BlenderBIM; later threads add Excel Latin-1 vs UTF-8 and NetFloorArea quantity questions
phrasing_notes: informal, step-by-step description of what was tried
answer_summary: Edit Pset properties not attributes; custom props entered as PsetName.PropName; quantity set is named BaseQuantities; Excel assumes Latin-1 so import via Data > From Text/CSV as UTF-8.

answer_summary: Meetups are practical show-and-tell with preference for live demos; topics include openBIM pledge and bSDD basics.

gloss_en: Draft OpenBIM Pledge as a plain-language contract condition so consultants deliver good IFC; asking how tiers can be written for design consultants

answer_summary: Author said pledge reflects real rollout experience of internal requirements and shortcomings in external ones; outreach to major Australian players under way.

gloss_en: Bonsai ramp and duct tools are too basic; NZ and AU stair and ramp rules differ and need local criteria
title_original: What's the core design intent behind Ramp Flight Tool & Duct Tool in Bonsai?
question_paraphrase: asked why ramp tool gives a thick flat plane and duct a plain box; reply from NZ/AU user explains NZ Building Code has four stair classes with tread, rise, nosing limits
phrasing_notes: curious beginner question, replies are long and technical
answer_summary: Ramp in IFC is a flat sloped plane; any custom shape can be classed IfcRamp; country rules need pluggable local criteria tables (2R+G or pitch angle).

gloss_en: Validation reports enumerated property rule violation on a BASIX-derived pset

phrasing_notes: terse, pastes raw error, no context about BASIX
answer_summary: Maintainer could not reproduce; error only appears when value not in enumeration; likely wrong test file or version.

gloss_en: 12d (popular Australian civil software) exports alignment IFC with no shapes or truncated geometry; what should viewers do

phrasing_notes: numbered questions, sends private sample files
answer_summary: Discussion of generating IfcCurveSegment from DesignParameters; behaviour for undefined vertical is underspecified.

gloss_en: Revit exports project north as both true north and grid north; cannot control them independently

answer_summary: Open Jira item; Australian participant explained grid north vs project north vs CRS north terminology used locally.

gloss_en: Revit exports MGA Zone 56 / GDA2020 CRS but IfcMapConversion Scale is null

answer_summary: Reporter shows scale null is a bug against IFC spec; fix requested in exporter.
